name: parrot-social

scripts.dev:frontend: pnpm --filter "@parrot-social/parrot_web^..." run --if-present build && pnpm --filter "@parrot-social/parrot_web..." --parallel run --if-present dev
scripts.dev:backend: pnpm --filter "@parrot-social/parrot_api^..." run --if-present build && pnpm --filter "@parrot-social/parrot_api..." --parallel run --if-present dev
scripts.build:frontend: pnpm --filter "@parrot-social/parrot_web^..." run --if-present build && pnpm --filter @parrot-social/parrot_web run build
scripts.build:backend: pnpm --filter "@parrot-social/parrot_api^..." run --if-present build && pnpm --filter @parrot-social/parrot_api run build

//: dev:* scripts build workspace dependencies once up front so dist/ exists, then run the app's own 'dev' script (watch mode) together with every workspace dependency's 'dev' (watch) script in parallel, so editing shared-dto while the app is running rebuilds it automatically.
